restart: Plan: restart the migrated database, JWT material, and frontend release together, then rerun parity.
restore: Plan: copy the stopped complete data directory into a fresh second target, boot it, and rerun probes.
rollback: Plan: stop the cutover copy, switch back to the stopped original unit, and verify its pre-switch credential before writes resume.
cutover: Plan: stop writes and workers, copy the complete stopped unit, boot the restored copy, and verify static, API, and credential behavior before switching traffic.
